row_ownership_semantics_OBSERVED_from_so.AddRow: DataTable.cpp -- RemoveRowInternal(name); FMemory::Malloc(GetStructureSize()); InitializeStruct; CopyScriptStruct(new, &RowData); AddRowInternal -> RowMap.Add
row_ownership_semantics_OBSERVED_from_so.EmptyTable: iterates RowMap, DestroyStruct + FMemory::Free each, then RowMap.Empty
row_ownership_semantics_OBSERVED_from_so.owner: The UDataTable owns every row value allocation end to end.
row_ownership_semantics_OBSERVED_from_so.aliasing_verdict: A row POINTER from one table must NEVER be inserted into another: both tables would own it and whichever removed/destructed first would DestroyStruct+Free it, leaving the other dangling. Proven from source, and avoided entirely by passing a SOURCE pointer that AddRow deep-copies FROM.

mechanism.RemoveRow: engine virtual, UDataTable vtable slot 94, Shipping RVA 0x355e170
mechanism.derivation: two agreeing lines -- (1) symbolized same-version UnrealEditor-Engine.dll exports ?AddRow@UDataTable@@ / ?RemoveRow@UDataTable@@ / ?EmptyTable@UDataTable@@ sitting CONSECUTIVELY in UDataTable's vtable at 260/259/258; (2) Shipping shape: slots 93/94/95 all call the same GetEmptyUsingStruct (0x3540fc0), which source shows EmptyTable, RemoveRowInternal and AddRow each begin with, and ONLY slot 95 calls the already-proven FMemory::Malloc (0xfab790). Editor indices were NOT transferred (WITH_EDITOR adds virtuals); only the relative order was used.
